verdict.rationale: Granola documents a RESTful API with programmatic access to notes, transcripts and AI summaries. Workspace admins can create API keys that belong to the workspace and don't expire, and that are scoped by note access, which suits unattended scripts and server-side automation. However, there is no evidence that the core capture and note-generation product can run without the desktop or mobile app, and no CLI or CI-oriented tooling is documented. Missing for 10: headless or CLI execution of the product itself, documented CI usage patterns, a published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404), and independent hands-on reports of headless automation.
